name: home-it
description: Home IT skills. Ships check-network: a repeatable playbook for home-network speed and DNS failures (compare system / router / public resolvers, inspect caches / upstreams / filters, measure throughput / bufferbloat / packet loss / Wi-Fi signal, localize the failing layer, inspect the router UI, and verify one fix at a time). The same SKILL.md files back the Claude Code plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose home-network speed and DNS failures
interface.longDescription: Home IT skills for the learn-yy-skills marketplace. check-network is a repeatable playbook for home-network speed and DNS failures. Its DNS branch compares the system resolver, LAN gateway and public controls, uses negative-cache TTLs to separate transient answers from persistent defects, inspects router upstreams and filters, changes one setting at a time, and verifies the real service before removing device overrides. Its performance branch measures throughput, loaded latency, packet loss and link quality across ISP, router, Wi-Fi path and client, then ranks fixes by leverage.
defaultPrompt: One domain returns NXDOMAIN at home but works through public DNS — diagnose and fix it.
My home Wi-Fi is slow at my desk — can we make it faster?
Should I buy an extender or a new router?
